summary: Former lookout in Wheeler County, OR; firelookout.com dates it only to the 1930s, and no source we read describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source we read describes what, if anything, remains.

events.note: Firelookout.com gives only the decade, '1930s', and marks the date unknown

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page names the same forest
Association list: Wheeler County, type unknown, status gone
page calls the lookout abandoned, with no date
page gives no account of the site today or public access

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says 'Abandoned' and the Association list says 'Gone'. Neither gives a date or a cause; the two labels are not explained by the sources.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one line of history on firelookout.com, no staffing, fire or visit data, and no present-day account. Coordinates differ by about 0.7 km: the record's point (44.46002, -120.29167, matching the Association list) against west_us_lookouts (44.4593, -120.30029). Not resolved here. A search snippet of the Forest Lookouts page mentioned a 1918 photo credited to the Bowman Museum in Prineville, but that caption is not in the cached page text, so it is left out and should be checked before use. A Wheeler County Fire & Rescue post about lookout history could not be read. No photo with a licence was found.
